title_zh: 要求用演示说明吸尘器性能

scenario.label_zh: 吸尘器宣传与实际演示询问
scenario.goal_zh: 说明吸入效果的需求并约定先观看演示再决定

context_zh: 顾客 Jonah 向虚构家电店店员 Amira 询问吸尘器，不涉及实际品牌或购买推荐。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: My old machine can barely suck up crumbs from the rug. I need to see what this one actually does.

sentences.speaker: Amira
sentences.text: The brochure calls its performance superior, but you don’t have to rely on that phrase.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Could you demonstrate it on the sample rug?

sentences.speaker: Amira
sentences.text: Yes. I can use the demonstration machine over there, with the shop’s test material.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Thanks. I’ll watch the test before deciding whether it suits me.
